subject: Getting started: Azure Marketplace publisher setup & technical validation
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@contoso.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contoso Procurement <procure@contoso.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace question: offer creation & timeline

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call today. We're interested in listing our new vector search appliance on Azure Marketplace and would like to understand the end-to-end process and timeline for: offer creation, identity/tenant proofing, co-sell opt-in, and private-offer/contracting mechanics.

High-level asks from Contoso:
- A checklist of required artifacts (identity, logos, DLLs/containers, pricing JSON).
- Who owns the publisher tenant vs. linked offer identity?
- Any common technical validation failures we should watch out for (networking, SPN, private link)?
- Estimated time to publish once we hand over artifacts.

We have procurement copied for contract questions and can share a signed NDA if needed.

Target: go-live before end-Nov if feasible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up call next week.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Product Partnerships, Contoso Cloud Platform
Sarah.Nguyen@contoso.com
+1 (425) 555-0123

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace question: offer creation & timeline

Hi Sarah — great to meet on the call. Short answer: timeline usually 4–8 weeks from start of artifact collection for a standard SaaS offer (can be longer for private/off-prem network proofing). I've attached a concise checklist to help you scope work and unify handoffs.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Download and complete the attached "publisher_onboarding_checklist_v1.pdf" (section A: identity, section B: artifacts).
2) Confirm who will own the Publisher Center tenant (Contoso preferred) and provide the tenant ID and primary admin.
3) Provide an SPN/service-principal for automated smoke tests or add our smoke-test account to a guest role (details in checklist).
4) If you require private offers or marketplace-managed metering, flag that now — there are additional steps for the SKU JSON and legal pairing.
5) We'll schedule a technical validation call with our infra team (Karthik) during artifact handoff.

I've CC'd Marissa (our Marketplace lead) and Naomi (partner ops) so they can track the intake. I'll loop in Karthik and Vivek for the technical validation runbook once the checklist is back.

If you'd like, here's a proposed working session window next Tue/Wed 9–11am PT. Confirm what works and we'll book.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai 
+1 (415) 555-0199

- Karthik: can you review the checklist notes about PrivateLink and SPN-based smoke testing? Contoso's architecture doc (summary below) suggests they will require VNet integration for autoscaling agents. If we need an on-prem connector, call that out.
- Vivek: pricing SKU JSON and co-sell opt-in flow — do we have a template that ensures billing and co-sell mapping to our HubSpot deal?

Hi Dylan and team — thanks for the checklist. Attaching the completed sections (identity proof + initial SKU mapping) and a signed NDA (attached). A few clarifying points from procurement and our cloud engineering team:

1) Publisher ownership: Contoso will own the Publisher Center tenant. Tenant ID: 8f9d-xxxx-zz12 (we'll provide full details in the secure form).
2) Private offers: We intend to use a private offer for initial pilot customers. Is there anything special you need from our side for co-sell opt-in when the offer is private?
3) SPN for smoke tests: We can create a scoped service principal with Reader + ACRPull roles. We prefer not to open any inbound ports; can smoke tests be performed from your guest SPN or will we need to grant a service endpoint?
4) Pricing: Procurement requested a simple SKU JSON example that includes meter dimensions for compute-hours and 'premium-support' add-on.

We attached: completed_checklist.xlsx, signed-non-disclosure.pdf.

Can we schedule the technical validation session for Mon 09/22 9am PT? Please confirm Karthik and Vivek availability and any pre-reads we should review.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Product Partnerships, Contoso Cloud Platform
